scoring_justification: Analytical M/E can be recomputed directly from the formula; inferred E_wall can be recomputed from M, phi, and nu. FEM M/E compared to analytical reference (paper confirms excellent agreement) with 10% tolerance, which is effectively a recompute-against-model check.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference analytical M/E values for comparison
hidden_assets.generation_method: computed from formula using standard floating-point arithmetic
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values are exact solutions to the publicly stated formula, not arbitrary

hidden_assets.source_provenance: inversion of analytical formula with M=34.5 GPa, phi=0.60, nu=0.28
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: exact solution to publicly stated inputs and formula

required.analytical: array of objects with porosity (float) and M_over_E (float)
required.fem: array of objects with porosity (float) and M_over_E (float)

outputs.description: Contains the M/E ratios from analytical and FEM simulations at porosities 0.35, 0.45, 0.55, 0.65, and the inferred pore-wall Young's modulus (in GPa) from the experimental pore-load modulus at porosity 0.60.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare the reported M_over_E values to reference digitized values with a relative tolerance, and recompute the inferred E_wall from the known inputs to verify internal consistency.

steps.description: validates JSON structure contains required keys and arrays of length 4
recomputes analytical M/E from formula and compares agent's analytical values with a tight tolerance
compares FEM M/E values to the analytical formula prediction (reference) with a relative tolerance of 10%
recomputes expected E_wall from M=34.5 GPa, phi=0.60, nu=0.28 and compares agent's inferred_E_GPa
